findings: The source covered request, vendor, approval, and spend views but its manifest language could imply autonomous PO and supplier action.
Vendor and approval outputs did not clearly distinguish evidence and recommendations from awards or recorded approvals.
Live strict isolation showed that the cloud-upgrade persona prompt could be answered without invoking ProcurementAgent.
fixes: Added no-PO, no-supplier-selection, no-contact, and no-funds-commitment boundaries.
Relabeled purchase, vendor, approval, and spend outputs as synthetic review evidence.
Expanded tool, operation, and request-ID descriptions with the exact cloud-upgrade, request-review, vendor, approval, and spend persona language.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow.
